transit-gtfs-local.purpose: Static transit schedule data (stops, routes, departures, arrivals, timetables, trip geometry) served from GTFS feeds imported into OpenMapX's own database
transit-gtfs-local.dataSent: Nothing is sent to a third party. Schedule data is served from OpenMapX's own PostGIS database; requests carry only an internal bounding box, stop ID, route ID, or trip ID and stay within OpenMapX's infrastructure.
transit-gtfs-local.dataReceived: Stops with coordinates and platforms, routes with operator and colors, scheduled departures and arrivals, full timetables, vehicle journeys, and trip geometry from the imported feeds
